card.name: Inside capitalized EMBRYO and AGGRAVATE
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the letter piece in the middle of an all-caps word, mostly the O in EMBRYO in EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY in boxed warning headings. It also fires on the V in AGGRAVATE.

modes.label: EMBRYO-FETAL heading
modes.description: The O ending EMBRY in the all-caps boxed warning title EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY.

modes.label: Other all-caps words
modes.description: A middle piece of other long capitalized words, such as AGGRAVATE or EMBRYOLOGY.
modes.example: INE, WHICH MAY FURTHER AGGRA<<V>>ATE DEHYDRATION AND ELECTRO

card.plain: It fires partway through the capitalized word EMBRYO in boxed warning titles about embryo-fetal toxicity.
